title: 7. Log Analysis for CTF / Exam 3
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L22: CTF Skills & Exam 3 Prep: 7. Log Analysis for CTF / Exam 3.

blocks.text: This skill is central to Exam 3. Master the pattern.

items: Lateral movement → access to other systems

blocks.text: The needle is often the lone success after many failures, or the outlier in volume / time / source IP.
Logs come from many sources. Correlate by:

rows: Sort all sources by time → reconstruct sequence
Trace one IP across firewall + auth + web logs
Follow one account from auth → file access → email
Build per-host timeline from process + network logs

blocks.text: Logs from different sources often have different timezones or formats. Always normalize to UTC before correlating.

[UTC time] [source] [event] [actor/target] 2026-04-15T02:14:03Z email-gw Phishing email delivered user1@org.tld 2026-04-15T02:32:11Z endpoint user1 opens .docm; macro executes HOST-A 2026-04-15T02:32:14Z edr powershell.exe spawned by winword HOST-A 2026-04-15T02:33:02Z proxy HTTPS to suspicious[.]example HOST-A → C2 2026-04-15T03:18:55Z ad-auth user1 lateral SMB to HOST-B HOST-A → HOST-B ... ```
Fill the template during the exam — don't wait until the end.
